observations.title: F62 same-tab 401 restores the same user’s unsent introduction without replay
steps: Web B normal OTP (challenge c5e35ee1, created 02:31:00Z) on unified-source-b:53016 → M4 Apply again → introduction typed, not sent.

A second tab signs B out explicitly (this is the cause of the 401; not a natural expiry). The original tab does not sign out; its Send gets POST applications 401 and moves to sign-in with returnTo the M4 apply page.

After the reviewed advance, B signs in again in the same tab (challenge 95dbbb1a, 02:31:30Z): the apply page returns; Apply again opens the editor with the exact 49-character introduction restored (49/300); no application created (B M4 round1 WITHDRAWN only).
